(B) Prepare a list of data tuples containing the records to be inserted
(C) Execute batch insertion using cur.executemany(sql, records) within a try block
(D) Call conn.commit() to finalize the transaction, or conn.rollback() inside the except block on error

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Batch transaction sequence: define SQL template -> prepare data tuples -> executemany -> commit on success or rollback on exception.
Hence Option C is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
